claim_class: controlled instance comparison on restored copies of the served catalog, not the workshop cluster
label: default-memory

client.placement: in-VPC EC2 client, same availability zone as both writers
client.query_sequence: anchors x presets, round-robin, shared position across workers

provenance.price_source: AWS Price List API, AmazonRDS, us-east-1, Aurora PostgreSQL, InstanceUsageIOOptimized on-demand
provenance.command: scripts/benchmark_hardware.py --control-label db.r8g.2xlarge --test-label db.r8gd.2xlarge --control-instance mosaic-hw-r8g-w --test-instance mosaic-hw-r8gd-w --concurrency 1 4 8 16 --duration 60 --warmup 45 --trials 2 --price-control 1.436 --price-test 1.6224 --build-workers 7 --build-memory 8GB --build-repeat 1 --label default-memory --output data/benchmarks/hardware_comparison_default-memory.json
provenance.method: same query text, parameters and configure_hnsw settings as the served probe; client latency is wall clock per query including the in-VPC network; recall is scored against exact neighbours seeded in each cluster; the table, TOAST and index are loaded with pg_prewarm on both sides before a recorded, uncounted warm-up; cache state is reported from pg_stat_database deltas, aurora_stat_optimized_reads_cache() and EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) text, never assumed

working_set.note: if the table and index fit in shared_buffers on both instances, the tiered cache has nothing to serve and a null result is expected

sizes.index_definition: CREATE INDEX real_search_vector_idx ON mosaic_catalog_search.product_document USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m='16', ef_construction='200')

prewarm.method: pg_prewarm on the table, its TOAST relation and the fp32 index, same order on both sides

index_builds.statement: CREATE INDEX "real_search_vector_idx_bench" ON "mosaic_catalog_search"."product_document" USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 200)
